claims: Integrity is the name of the Orion spacecraft used for NASA's Artemis II mission.
NASA's Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission carried four astronauts on a 10-day mission around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission's goal is to test the human life support systems and Orion’s capabilities.
The Artemis II mission takes humans further into space than they have traveled since 1972.
Reid Wiseman commands the Artemis II mission.
Victor Glover is the pilot of the Artemis II mission.
Christina Koch is a mission specialist of the Artemis II mission.
Jeremy Hansen is a mission specialist of the Artemis II mission for the Canadian Space Agency (CSA).
The Integrity spacecraft is equipped with advanced environmental control.
The Integrity spacecraft has updated flight displays.
The Integrity spacecraft has a fully functional Launch Abort System (LAS).
The Integrity spacecraft has an experimental laser communication system for enhanced data transmission to Houston.
The Integrity spacecraft utilizes solar array wings (SAWs) that provide 63 feet of span.
The Integrity spacecraft's SAWs feature 15,000 solar cells.
The solar cells power the European Service Module.
The Artemis II mission includes a 400,000-kilometer journey away from Earth.
The Artemis II flight serves as the final crewed test before future crewed moon landings under the Artemis program.
